lines.en: [<Star Stream> has confirmed the possibility of a new ‘Giant Story’.]
[The possibilities of old Stories are being reinterpreted!]
[The roles in the myth are being recast!]
[「Stage Transformation」 based on the ancient myth is in progress!]
The great dokkaebi ‘Noksu’ remained silent as indirect messages erupted one after another.
Normally, the dokkaebis did not broadcast the sixtieth scenario, <Gigantomachia>. They held only the channels and broadcasting rights; the lesser heroes of <Olympus> handled the actual proceedings.
But now that something so unexpected had happened, things had changed.
The thunder of explosions from the screen, and the roars of the Gigantes that had burst out of the ground.
—Where the hell did those giants come from?
—The <Underworld>! What happened to the <Underworld>?
—Those bastards should be locked in an underground prison! How······!
The <Gigantomachia> about to unfold was an entirely different story.
“······Who will be broadcasting it?”
Noksu turned toward two advanced dokkaebis.
“I'll do it.”
“No, I'm going.”
Bihyung, branch director of the Korean Peninsula, and Dokgak, branch director of Japan.
Tzzzzzt!
Their eyes met, and sparks crackled through the air.
Dokgak shouted.
“Great Dokkaebi! It can't be Bihyung. He's been broadcasting the incarnation ‘Kim Dokja’ for far too long.”
“That familiarity means I can do it better, you idiot. And how long are you going to keep calling him an incarnation? He's a constellation now.”

The screen showed the incarnations of <Kim Dokja’s Company> fighting the heroes. Holding precise formations against the oncoming ‘Status’, they resembled a brilliant constellation gathered around a single star.
Crunch.
The sound of someone chewing popcorn came from somewhere.
[You're a noisy bunch. Do dokkaebis always talk this much?]
The red wine sloshing in the glass was sucked into the man's mouth.
Then another hero of <Olympus> died on the screen.
[The constellation ‘God of Wine and Ecstasy’ cheers!]
[The constellation ‘God of Wine and Ecstasy’ has sponsored ‘Demon King of Salvation’ with 3,000 coins!]
Faced with that absurd sight, Bihyung spoke.
“Aren't you a member of <Olympus>, Constellation-nim? Is it all right for you to be relaxing here?”
[What do I care? I've never been close to them. And you're the ones who said I could come on a tour today, aren't you?]
Like someone who had come out to cheer in the streets, Dionysus had a flagpole stuck on his back. Its banner fluttered with the words ‘Down with Olympus’ in Gulim font.
Dokgak narrowed his eyes.
“The other Twelve Seats should be gathered at the <Temple of Olympus> by now.”
[I want Kim Dokja's bunch to win.]
“Pardon?”
The sudden bombshell set the dokkaebis murmuring.
Dionysus laughed heartily.
[What's so surprising? Anyone can cheer for whoever they like. And you shouldn't be reacting like that. I thought all dokkaebis needed was an ‘interesting scenario.’]
He had a point, so the dokkaebis nodded.
Dokgak said,
“What you're hoping for won't happen.”
Even Bihyung's expression darkened at Dokgak's words.
In truth, the battle <Kim Dokja’s Company> had picked with <Olympus> was absurd. Forget striking a rock with an egg—even a quail's egg would have better odds than they did.
And now the trouble on ‘Earth’ was unfolding at the same time.
While Bihyung watched <Gigantomachia> begin, his other retina showed Yoo Joonghyuk running with Lee Sookyung on his back.
Then Dionysus spoke.
[We won't know whether this story is a tragedy or a comedy until it's over.]
“······Isn't it obvious at this point? That's the kind of scenario <Gigantomachia> is.”

[<Gigantomachia> is only part of the Giant Stories <Olympus> possesses. They aren't particularly desperate, so they'll be underestimating their opponents. We can't entirely rule out the possibility that a lucky punch catches them off guard and knocks them flat.]
“Odds approaching zero don't count as odds.”
[Isn't that why I'm sitting here doing this—because something that unlikely is actually going to happen?]
Watching the screen, Dionysus stuffed popcorn into his mouth.
[The question is······what our ‘fish ajusshi’ will do······.]
More than half the seats of the rarely assembled Twelve Seats were occupied.
Each had taken the form of a symbolic body representing its owner.
The trident spoke first.
[Our illustrious Lightning Throne hasn't come this time either······and Dionysus is absent too?]
[That's correct.]
Rumble.
The seawater around the temple seethed, as though a great ocean were rising in anger.
As several tense symbolic bodies exchanged glances, the trident spoke.
[So, why have the ‘giants’ awakened again?]
[They reportedly staged a mass escape from <Tartarus>.]
The answer came from a constellation whose symbolic body was a pair of swords.
The trident asked again.
[······Hades wouldn't have stood by and done nothing, would he?]
[They are said to have performed a ‘mythical ritual.’]
[A ‘mythical ritual’? That would have cost enormous probability······Don't tell me ‘Everybody’s Mother’ has awakened?]
[No. Only the three Hecatoncheires brothers and the Gigantes have moved.]
[All three brothers came out?]
[Only Briareus. Even he is said to have lost half his hundred hands (百手).]
[I suppose there wouldn't have been enough probability for all three.]
Silence fell over the assembly.
The blazing sun spoke.
[We can't stand by and watch this. <Kim Dokja’s Company>? A paltry little nebula like that dared provoke us?]
[Severe punishment is certainly in order.]
Then a winged shoe, surrounded by countless data windows, spoke.
[It won't be easy. That nebula's master has received a ■■ containing a ‘hint of the end,’ just like the three principal gods.]
[······Is that true, Hermes?]
[Yes.]
[Hah. Ridiculous. The master of a minor nebula is accumulating a ‘Story’ on the same level as that of the ‘Lightning Throne’?]
The assembly stirred.
‘A Single Story’ was a sensitive subject for all the Twelve Seats.
Constellations were beings who sought the ultimate story.
Not one constellation was uninterested in a finale bearing a ‘hint of the end.’
The trident brought the discussion to a close.
[Quiet. You all have business to attend to, and I have work of my own. Let us begin the vote.]
Every Seat in the assembly fell silent.
It had been a long time since this many Seats had gathered over a mere scenario in the sixties.
[As chairman, I call for the deployment of our Story Weapons in response to <Kim Dokja’s Company>'s provocation.]
The vote began.
[The constellation ‘God of Marriage and the Home’ abstains.]
[The constellation ‘Organizer of Agriculture and the Seasons’ declares neutrality.]
[The constellation ‘Spokesman of Justice and Wisdom’ declares that, whatever may be said of the humans, the giants must face the hammer of justice.]
[The constellation ‘Atrocious God of War’ desires war with the giants.]
[The constellation ‘Almighty Sun’ wishes to burn the insignificant minor nebula.]
[The constellation ‘Volcanic Blacksmith’ wishes to forge weapons to oppose the giants.]
[The constellation ‘Pure Hunter of the Moonlight’ rejects a meaningless war.]
[The constellation ‘Goddess of Love and Beauty’ abstains, declaring that she will not take part in a vulgar vote.]

[The constellation ‘Master of the Skywalk’ states that this issue should not be approached so simply, and that the substance of the matter must be examined after reviewing a more extensive body of data and first assessing the behavior of the enraged giants······.]
[Hermes, keep it brief.]
[The constellation ‘Master of the Skywalk’ opposes the war.]
Several constellations whispered at that declaration.
[What a coward, Hermes.]
[He's always opposed the temple's wishes at every turn······.]
Hermes said nothing.
Meanwhile, the voting results appeared.
[For: 4 votes]
[Against: 2 votes]
[Abstentions: 3 votes]
One final vote remained.
The chairman's, of course.
[The constellation ‘Spear that Parts the Boundaries of the Sea’ calls for deployment.]
[For: 5 votes]
[Every seat, excluding absentees, has cast its vote.]
The trident nodded.
[As more than half have voted in favor, excluding abstentions, I declare the deployment of the ‘Story Weapons’.]
A gavel rang throughout the temple, and ominous foam rose across the sea. It was moving toward the <Gigantomachia> theme park, where giants were running rampant.
[We need commanders to lead the weapons. Historical-grade constellations will accompany them, but they cannot handle the giants alone.]
[Who else will you send?]
[Let two or so of the Seats who voted in favor go. Their incarnation bodies should be enough to settle this. Please volunteer freely.]
Then someone raised a hand.
[I'll go.]
After Achilles' incarnation body fell, the incarnations panicked. Some discovered the mountains of ‘giants’ rising everywhere and began to flee.
Amid the confusion, a group of incarnations shouted.
“Why are you doing this?”
“You! What the hell have you done?”
Their shock and anger soon turned on me.
I asked breezily in return.
“What seems to be the problem? What did I do?”
“You've cost us our chance to get Star Relics!”
“We could've earned Stories about hunting giants!”
“We could've caught the Twelve Seats' attention and joined <Olympus>! But because of you······!”
<Gigantomachia>.
A chance to obtain hidden elixirs and, with luck, even a fragment of a Giant Story, for an entry fee of only 100,000 coins.
Before their eyes, that chance was crumbling to dust.
I looked at the incarnations and spoke.
“······Do you really think <Gigantomachia> is such an innocent event?”
Perhaps they were right.
There really were constellations and incarnations who grew stronger through <Gigantomachia>.
And most of them would very likely become members of <Olympus>.
“Let's say you join <Olympus>. What will you do then?”
“I'm asking what you could possibly do in a nebula where the Twelve Seats and the ancient constellations have already claimed everything.”

Through ‘Ways of Survival’, I had seen how countless incarnations who joined <Olympus> through <Gigantomachia> ended up. Incarnations who would be bound by unfair contracts, collect paltry Stories, and be used as pawns in countless scenarios.
“The incarnations from the previous <Gigantomachia> all went on to higher scenarios! They······!”
“You mean them?”
People turned in the direction I pointed.
The Argo was cutting through the sea, followed by countless other ships.
Among their passengers, I could see participants from the previous <Gigantomachia>.
“······W-why are they here?”
<Gigantomachia>
A myth recorded as a war between the giants on one side and the gods and heroes of <Olympus> on the other.
But most incarnations had no idea how the heroes who actually fought that war had been made.
[Many constellations grow excited!]
How many humans the gods, afraid of the giants, had raped to mass-produce ‘heroes’ in preparation for <Gigantomachia>.
[The constellations of nebula <Olympus> show hostility toward you.]
The participants had no idea how many incarnations were still being conscripted into this horrific war of ‘reenactment’, even after <Gigantomachia> had ended.
Like a snake biting its own tail, a scenario that consumed itself and produced itself.
[Many constellations enter the channel!]
[Many constellations cannot hide their excitement over <Gigantomachia>!]
Constellations who had hated the scenarios reached the end of the scenarios and came to enjoy those scenarios.
Mocking the incarnations desperately climbing the ladder of scenarios, and kicking away the ladders leading to the top, one by one.
And so the victims of tragedy became its perpetrators in turn.
I spoke to the terrified incarnations.
“I want to destroy this scenario.”
“Destroy the scenario? What on earth are you······?”
They looked as though they understood nothing of what I meant.
Of course they didn't.
Beings who had barely managed to clear scenarios and survive within them could hardly conceive of such a thing.
The scenarios had already become a condition of their lives.
[What a bold constellation! You intend to stand against <Olympus>?]
I turned toward the voice and found a familiar giant of a man.
A great spear one zhang and eight chi long, and a shaggy beard.
He was a constellation I knew.
“Yes.”
[Hahahaha! If you don't mind, may I ask your name?]
“I'm the ‘Demon King of Salvation.’”
Demon King of Salvation.
Several incarnations and constellations reacted immediately to my modifier.
“Could he be from the ‘Demon King Selection’······?”
“It's the demon king who defeated S-Surya!”
The man with the great spear stepped forward.
[I am called the ‘Protector of Changban.’]
“Protector of Changban! Zhang Fei's here too!”
Zhang Fei thumped his enormous chest and shouted.
[I, Zhang, would like to help you. I'd lost all enthusiasm for this childish game anyway!]
As he spoke, Zhang Fei flung away the things he'd collected in the <Olympus> theme park. A young Hydra's head, golden apples, and a fake golden fleece tumbled out.
I nodded.
“Very well.”
A Historical-grade constellation like Zhang Fei would certainly be a great asset.
But he alone wasn't enough.
[The hidden scenario ‘Myth Subversion’ influences the main scenario.]
I turned to the other incarnations and constellations and shouted.
“Now make your choice.”
The incarnations watched me, caught between the terrifying Status of the giants and the Argo bearing down on us across the sea.
“Will you cling to the coattails of a great nebula and serve as its hands and feet for the rest of your lives? Or will you join the giants of this myth and become the masters of a new ‘myth’?”
[The ‘main scenario’ assigned to you and your nebula is being updated!]
<Main Scenario #60 — Gigantomachia>
Category: Main
Difficulty: SSS+

Clear Conditions: The ancient giants have arrived on the battlefield of <Gigantomachia>. You may participate on the side of either the ‘giants’ or <Olympus>. Behead the enemy leaders and proclaim the birth of a new myth to <Star Stream>!
Time Limit: —
Reward: A new Giant Story, ???
Failure: Loss of part of the ‘Giant Story’ in your possession
● The scenario will end when the enemy leader's incarnation body is destroyed.
● Each faction has two leaders.
The moment I received the scenario, a green arrow appeared over my head.
[You already belong to a faction.]
[You are one of the two leaders of the ‘giant’ faction.]
The incarnations around me said nothing.
They had probably received the updated scenario too.
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ enjoys this rare spectacle.]
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ enjoys your suffering.]
[The constellation ‘Secretive Plotter’ is curious about your strategy.]
That was when the bombardment began from the sea.
Han Sooyoung's sharp voice rang out.
“Kim Dokja! How long are you going to stand there posing? Do you want to watch everyone fucking die?”
I drew my sword and descended from the giant's shoulder.
“Let's get started.”
“How are we going to fight? We're overwhelmingly outmatched.”
Han Sooyoung was right.

Even if ‘overwhelmingly’ was a little much, fewer than ten giants had crossed the portal with me so far. And ‘Briareus’ of the Hecatoncheires, our main fighting force, hadn't even entered the battle yet.
He was probably the other ‘leader’ of the giant faction.
[Kill the giants.]
A True Voice rang out from somewhere, and human heroes leaping from the Argo began to attack the giants.
[Stage Transformation of ‘Gigantomachia’ is in progress.]
With a crackling tzzzzzt, the scenery around us changed.
An ancient battlefield.
The land of slaughter where the first <Gigantomachia> had taken place.
The constellations of <Olympus> flew through the sky.
Most were Historical-grade, but when they joined forces and unleashed a fierce assault on the giants, the tide of battle turned in an instant.
「Under the combined assault of heroes and gods, the supreme giants shall fall to their knees.」
Graaaooooh!
Beneath the attacks of gods and heroes together, the mighty Gigantes were dropping to their knees, one after another.
My companions and I tried to help them, but whenever we moved, a monstrous hail of cannon fire from the sea pinned us down.
Lee Hyunsung shouted.
“I think we need to do something about that Story Weapon first!”
The Story Weapon ‘Argo.’
The ship carrying <Olympus>'s expeditionary heroes was firing shells loaded with enormous magic power in rapid succession. At this rate, even approaching the sea would be difficult.
Of course, I had expected this.
“Have you forgotten who's with us?”
I looked at a girl standing blank-faced among our companions.
More precisely, I was looking at the constellation watching over Lee Jihye.
[The constellation ‘Maritime War God’ looks at you.]
Lee Jihye cried out in alarm.
“······Are you insane? You want me to take that on?”

The Argo of <Olympus> was far larger than the ships of Lee Jihye's ‘Ghost Fleet.’ If I had to compare them, it was roughly the difference between a corvette and an Aegis warship. Naturally, she thought it was impossible.
“You can do it.”
I knew.
Lee Jihye really could.
“With your sponsor, you can.”
Under the eyes of the Korean Peninsula's constellations, the Maritime War God looked up at the sky.
A constellation long confined to the ‘Korean Peninsula.’
A constellation who had been made to bear a nation's name.
Who had to dedicate his entire life to remaining its symbol.
‘Goryeo’s First Sword’ had once said
that among the Korean Peninsula's Historical-grade constellations, only the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare could rival him.
Then why, even after ‘Goryeo’s First Sword’ became Narrative-grade, had the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare remained ‘Historical-grade’?
[The constellation ‘Maritime War God’ looks at his comrades.]
Because he had refused to become Narrative-grade.
[The constellation ‘Seo Ae Il Pil’ wishes for ‘Maritime War God’ to fight for himself.]
There came a moment when a constellation that began as ‘Historical-grade’ became ‘Narrative-grade.’
The moment it left behind the bounds of a people or nation and followed its own path.
Dazzling light rose from Lee Jihye's body.
[The constellation ‘Maritime War God’ releases his Status.]
The Status held by the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare unfolded, as though he were laying his whole self bare.
[<Star Stream> gazes upon the constellation ‘Maritime War God.’]

The scenario's sky looked down at the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare. Like a seasoned actor who had kept his abilities hidden all this time, his Status rose toward the sky, boundlessly magnificent and composed.
A spirit that neither retreated nor feared.
[Many constellations are astonished by the Status of ‘Maritime War God’!]
After all those long years, the Duke of Loyalty and Warfare was finally moving beyond the Korean Peninsula.
[<Star Stream> accepts the promotion of ‘Maritime War God.’]
[The constellation ‘Maritime War God’ has become a ‘Narrative-grade constellation’.]
“Jihye.”
The battle of <Gigantomachia> would begin in the name of the Maritime Admiral (海上提督).
“Destroy them all.”
Enveloped in the spirit of the ‘Maritime War God,’ Lee Jihye drew her sword.
[The character ‘Lee Jihye’ activates the stigma ‘Ghost Fleet Lv.10’!]
[The rise in her sponsor's Status sharply increases the destructive power of ‘Ghost Fleet’!]
Rumble!
Twelve ships cutting across the coastline as they appeared.
The vessels that should have been corvette-sized had grown to the size of destroyers.
「The art of war says: those who seek death shall live, and those who seek life shall die.」
A fleet of twelve ships opening fire together.
At first the numbers of shells seemed evenly matched, but that began to change as time passed.
The Argo's bow was being crushed. Its rate of fire plummeted, and the sound of its hull bursting rang out again and again.
Even that sturdy Argo was shaking.
With a screen of fire to defend us from the shells, we moved too. Cutting down the <Olympus> incarnations charging the giants, we advanced to the front line.
Apparently deciding that this couldn't continue, the heroes aboard the Argo finally stepped in.
[Everyone, ashore!]
The one who appeared with that powerful True Voice was the Argo's expedition leader, the ‘Wind Expedition King.’ Jason, leader of the Argo's expedition.
[The giants cannot withstand the combined assault of humans and gods! The outcome of this war is already decided!]
Troops pouring out with a roar.
I stepped ahead of my hesitant companions.
“There's no need to be afraid. We aren't giants.”
We weren't giants.
In other words, 「Stage Transformation」 had no effect on us.
As the burly Jason charged toward us, a giant of a man rushed out from our side to meet him.
“I'll take the big one.”
Lee Hyunsung.
He collided with Jason in a tremendous charge, then locked hands with him as though testing their strength and let out a battle cry.
“Haaaaah!”
Crrrumble!
The contest of strength was powerful enough to shift the very ground around them. Even Jason looked startled.
As ‘Ways of Survival’ progressed into its later stages, Lee Hyunsung was second to no incarnation or constellation in sheer strength.
[The constellation ‘Master of Steel’ increases the synchronization rate!]
A steel shell creaked as it grew to encase Lee Hyunsung's entire body.
The realm he had reached with [Steel Transformation] was truly exceptional.
Even under a hero's punches, his body didn't budge.
In the sky, Shin Yoosung and Lee Gilyoung flew on a dragon.

Shin Yoosung kept clear of heroes with dragon-slaying Stories and sprayed breath attacks through the air. Poisonous mist soon spread across the sea; Lee Gilyoung's monsters of the insect king species slipped through it and cut down their choking enemies.
I could also see Lee Seolhwa fighting heroes with poisonous claws, and Han Sooyoung activating [Black Flames] to block the constellations of <Olympus>.
They had all grown capable of handling at least one Historical-grade constellation. A nebula with only a little over ten members was standing against the constellations of that mighty great nebula.
The incarnations watching from the rear began to murmur.
“What? It looks like Olympus is getting pushed back······?”
“······By such a small nebula?”
That was exactly the effect I'd been aiming for.
The battle had only just begun.
We had to show our strength now to draw in more reinforcements.
But Nike, goddess of victory, didn't seem inclined to favor us yet.
Rumble!
······There it was at last.
I looked up at the twenty-meter monster filling my vision.
However you looked at it, that was far too tall for a human.
Dazzling golden armor. A lion's skin draped like a cape. Even someone who knew little of Greek and Roman mythology couldn't fail to know his name.
Several giants faltered at that majestic appearance and cried out.
[Heracles······!]
The hero's ‘Status’, enough to make even the Twelve Seats wary, seized the entire battlefield.
Looking up at the dark shadow looming over us, I smiled bitterly.
To fight a monster, we'd have to call a monster of our own.
It had taken a very long time to get this far.
Naturally, I wasn't backing down now.
“······O sword forged to cut down the sleeping giant.”
I quietly spoke the activation phrase.
“Descend here, now.”
Come, Kim Namwoon.
A swirling portal opened in the air.
[The constellation ‘Queen of the Darkest Spring’ watches you.]
I had won permission to use Pluto from Hades.
For this <Gigantomachia> alone, I could use Pluto freely.
[Hahahaha, Grasshopper Man! You sure remember that activation phrase well for someone who hated it!]
Kim Namwoon's teasing voice.
But the Giant Soldier didn't appear right away.
All I could see beyond the swirling portal was the darkness of a bottomless abyss.
[······Actually, could you wait ten minutes? The summoning circle here is broken, so I don't think I can go right away. The giants stamped their feet too much······.]
······Fucking hell.
Heracles stared at us expressionlessly, venting white steam.
There was no choice. I'd have to buy whatever time I could.
I took a step forward and shouted.
“Heracles! ‘Great Hero of the Twelve Labors’!”
Heracles looked at me.
A red arrow blinked above Heracles' head.
[This constellation is a ‘leader’ of the <Olympus> faction.]
As expected, he was apparently one of <Olympus>'s two ‘leaders.’
According to the myth, Heracles had killed the leader of the giants during <Gigantomachia>, so it was only natural.
Many constellations in ‘Ways of Survival’ had said,
「“As long as Heracles is here, the victor of <Gigantomachia> will never change.”」
Countless incarnations seeing Heracles for the first time cheered.
“Ooooooh!”
“Heracles! It's Heracles!”
Heracles, the great hero of Olympus who had left behind countless legends and myths.
Despite all those Stories echoing throughout <Star Stream>, only a handful of incarnations or constellations had actually seen him.
They said he was a demigod (半神), born of a god and a human.
That his body was forged from steel.
That he was the guardian of <Olympus>. Nothing but rumors.
[The Story ‘One Who Strangled the Nemean Lion’ begins its storytelling.]
[The Story ‘One Who Beat Up the Giant Boar’ begins its storytelling.]
[The Story ‘One Who Subdued Cerberus Barehanded’ begins its storytelling.]
I could see tremendous Stories rippling over Heracles' entire body.
Even at a glance, they were insane.
Every one was at least Legendary-grade.
The Status of the ‘Giant Stories’ he had accumulated was on an entirely different level from mine.
But I hadn't started this game without knowing that.
“As expected, you can't trust the rumors in <Star Stream>.”
At my taunt, Heracles hurled a fist the size of a house at me.
[Activating the exclusive skill ‘Bookmark’!]
[Miniaturization] and [Electrification] activated a split second apart.
Heracles' fist skimmed over my head, smashed the ground where I'd stood, and left a crater.
Even as I breathed a sigh of relief at escaping that brute force, I kept taunting him.
“At least you can throw a decent punch. Though I find it hard to believe that was enough to subdue the giants.”
Something like an indignant cry came from within Heracles' body.

“I know a number of legends about you. You killed the Nemean Lion, slew the Hydra, hunted the Stymphalian Birds······Stories so incredible it's hard to believe ‘one person’ could have done all that in such a short time.”
At last, a True Voice burst from inside Heracles.
[Yes. That is who I am—‘Heracles’!]
A voice whose very sound sent chills through me.
It undoubtedly carried Status on par with the Twelve Seats.
But that made my conviction all the stronger.
“I've heard that you were born for <Gigantomachia>. And that your Twelve Labors were all trials assigned to ensure victory in <Gigantomachia>.”
[Several constellations take an interest in your story!]
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ worries about you.]
However he took my words, Heracles thumped his chest. A monster over twenty meters tall doing that was quite a sight.
I continued.
“But one of my close companions once heard your story and raised a question.”
Suppressing the anger boiling inside me, I went on.
“‘Originally, Heracles was a human born after the age of the ‘Great Flood’. So how could he have taken part in <Gigantomachia>, which happened before that?’”
The one who said that was none other than Yoo Sangah.
The constellations in the channel began to murmur.
Heracles glared and unleashed his True Voice.
[You insolent wretch! Are you accusing me, Heracles, of lying?]
“Yeah. And not just you. All the Twelve Seats.”
My immediate answer briefly shut Heracles up.
“You've made too many ‘false Stories.’ You even tampered with the chronology.”
Heracles looked unmistakably rattled.
“It baffled me too. The idea that if you keep spouting bullshit, and spouting it, and spouting it······one day it might become a ‘real Story.’”
A thousand years. Two thousand.
Lies repeated for thousands and tens of thousands of years.
“And once it becomes a Story, you can even say that ‘something that never existed’ was ‘there all along’······Stories are fascinating things, aren't they?”
[I am Heracles! Heracles, hero of <Gigantomachia> and symbol of <Olympus>!]
“Sure, perhaps you were in some worldline. But somewhere in another worldline, maybe there is a hero who really beat down the Nemean Lion and the Hydra······a hero like that.”
[The constellation ‘Secretive Plotter’ smiles with interest.]
As I spoke, I looked up at the sky.
I remembered the countless rounds of Yoo Joonghyuk I had brushed past during my journey through the 1863rd round.
“But not this worldline. In this worldline, a hero like ‘Heracles’ doesn't exist.”
[You bastard!]
“Because Heracles is the name of the ‘Story Weapon’ you made.”
Zeus, god of lightning, had sown his seed in preparation for <Gigantomachia>.
But, as always, ‘seed’ here was a metaphor.
Afraid of the giants' rise to power, Zeus crossed worldlines, collecting all manner of heroic Stories.
「The Nemean Lion」
「The Golden-Horned Deer」
「The Cretan Bull」
「The Nine-Headed Hydra」
He gathered those Stories and created ‘a single individual.’
That individual soon took shape as a ‘Story Weapon.’
A being powered by human souls, created solely to fight the ‘giants.’
A terror of <Star Stream>, a weapon that had brought the horror of slaughter to countless battlefields.
“Giant Soldier (巨神兵), Heracles.”
[The constellation ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ is surprised.]
[The constellation ‘Bald General of Justice’ is outraged at the atrocities of <Olympus>!]
[The expression of the constellation ‘Queen of the Darkest Spring’ turns cold and rigid.]
[The eyes of the constellation ‘Spokesman of Justice and Wisdom’ waver.]
[Many constellations are shocked by the identity of ‘Heracles’!]
